description: Add only a short ivory and brass lighthouse staff held in the right hand, vertical shaft and small amber crystal at its top to this north-facing, back-view human. Fit the object to the existing right hand without moving the fingers. Match the nautical pixel art scale and shading. Preserve face, bald head, body, limbs, shorts, pose and transparent 64x64 canvas. No clothing, hair, extra hands, aura or particles.
